title: Team Leader
description:
Confira a vaga para Team Leader em santa maria. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

The Team Leader is responsible for assisting the Store Manager and Assistant Store Manager with the execution of operational, sales, and merchandising objectives by delivering a Legendary Customer Experience. The Team Leader is also responsible for promoting a safe and productive work environment for all Team Members, customers, and vendors, as well as training Team Members on the appropriate application of policies and procedures.  Do you love the life out here and want to share it with others? At Tractor Supply we strive to make the life out here a little bit better each day for both our neighbors and our teams.  Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)   Maintain regular and predictable attendance.  Work scheduled shifts, and have the ability to work varied hours, days, nights, weekends, and overtime as dictated by business needs.  Uphold and promote a safe and productive work environment by following and enforcing policies and procedures.  Deliver on our promise of Legendary Customer Service through GURA:    Greet the Customer.  Uncover Customer’s Needs & Wants.  Recommend Product Solutions.  Ask to Add Value & Appreciate the Customer.      The Team Leader is required to perform a combination of the following duties during 95 percent of their day. Although the mix may vary from one day to another, our business and staffing model makes it essential that every person in the Team Leader position be able to perform all of the following duties accurately, efficiently and safely on a regular basis and without advance notice:    Execute assigned basic, promotional, and seasonal merchandising activities.  Perform Opening/Closing procedures.  Transport and make deposits to bank.  Assess store conditions and assign duties.  Organize and prioritize workflow through the use of the daily planner.  Recovery of merchandise.  Participate in mandatory freight process.  Perform regular and promotional price change activities.  Resolve customer complaints/issues and ensure the customer has a Legendary shopping experience that differentiates from the competition.  Adhere to loss prevention standards and respond to any alarm calls as needed.  Communicate with Team Members on job functions, responsibilities and financial goals.  Operate cash register/computer supervising cash handling procedures.  Assist Team Members on appropriate application of policies and procedures.  Ensure the safety and well-being of birds. Sanitize and maintain poultry holding tanks and care for birds as required.  Operate Forklift and Baler.  Complete all documentation associated with any of the above job duties.  Obtain license or certifications as needed by the business.      May be required to perform other duties as assigned.    Required Qualifications  Experience: Retail experience and/or farming, ranching, pet/equine, or welding knowledge is strongly preferred. Supervisory experience preferred. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license.  Education: High school diploma or equivalent is preferred, but not required. Regardless of education level, you must be able to read, write, and count accurately.  Preferred knowledge, skills or abilities   Basic computer skills.  Ability to read, write, and count accurately.  Strong interpersonal skills and ability to resolve issues ethically and with minimal conflict.  Ability to perform and execute principle responsibilities of Team Members.    Working Conditions   Working environment is favorable, generally working inside with moderate noise.  Work shifts vary from one store to another, but generally are no less than 4 hours and may exceed 8 hours.  Promote a safe and productive work environment for Team Members and customers and adhere to Company safety training and guidelines.  Indoor floors and outdoor lots generally are hard surfaces (concrete, asphalt, etc.) lighting and temperature are adequate.  Ability to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions.    Physical Requirements   Ability to move and transfer merchandise, weighing up to 50 pounds, throughout the store.  Ability to push and pull merchandise up to 2,000 pounds with the assistance of proper material handling equipment (e.g. pallet jack).  Ability to occasionally lift or reach merchandise overhead.  Ability to frequently stand, kneel, twist, crouch, squat, bend, stoop, and climb ladders.  Ability to move throughout the store for an entire shift.  Ability to safely access all areas of the store including selling floor, side lot, stock area, and register area.  Ability to operate and use all equipment necessary to run a store (e.g. dolly, handtruck, forklift, baler, computer, cash register) (forklift and baler requirements do not apply if under the age of 18).  Ability to constantly operate store equipment such as computer, cash register, and other store equipment.  Ability to read, write, and count accurately to complete all documentation.  Ability to utilize strong written and verbal communication skills to communicate effectively with team members and customers.  Ability to process information / merchandise through the point-of-sale system.  Ability to handle and be in contact with birds/poultry.  Ability to successfully complete training and certification to dispense propane, and to dispense propane (propane certification and dispensing requirement does not apply if under the age of 18).  Ability to successfully complete all required training.  Ability to travel as required in support of district needs.  Ability to drive or operate a vehicle for business needs.  This position is non-sedentary.  Ability to successfully complete training and certification for various business needs.    Disclaimer  This job description represents an overview of the responsibilities for the above referenced position. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive list of responsibilities. A team member should perform all duties as assigned by his/her supervisor.  Company Info  At Tractor Supply and Petsense by Tractor Supply, our Team Members are the heart of our success. Their dedication, passion, and hard work drive everything we do, and we are committed to supporting them with a comprehensive and accessible total reward package. We understand the evolving needs of our Team Members and their families, and we strive to offer meaningful, competitive, and sustainable benefits that support their well‑being today and in the future.  Our benefits extend beyond medical, dental, and vision coverage, including company‑paid life and disability insurance, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement, and family planning resources such as adoption and surrogacy assistance, for all full‑time Team Members and all part‑time Team Members. Part time new hires gain eligibility for TSC Benefits by averaging at least 15 hours per week during their 90‑day lookback period. The lookback period starts the first of the month following the date of hire. If the 15‑hour requirement was met, the benefits eligibility date will be the first day of the month following 4 months of continuous service.  Please visit this link for more specific information about the benefits and leave policies applicable to the position you’re applying for.  ALREADY A TEAM MEMBER?  You must apply or refer a friend through our internal portal.  Our Mission and Values  Our Mission and Values are more than just words on the wall - they’re the one constant in an ever‑changing environment and the bedrock on which we build our culture. They're the core of who we are and the foundation of every decision we make. It’s not just what we do that sets us apart, but how we do it.  We believe in managing your time for business and personal success, which is why we empower our Team Members to lead balanced lives through our benefits and total rewards offerings. For full‑time and eligible part‑time TSC and Petsense Team Members. We care about what you care about!  A lot of care goes into providing legendary service at Tractor Supply Company, which is why our Team Members are our top priority. Want a career with a clear path for growth? Your Opportunity is Out Here at Tractor Supply and Petsense.  Nearest Major Market:  Santa Barbara  Nearest Secondary Market:  Santa Maria   #J-18808-Ljbffr

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.  Overview  With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.  This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.  We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.  Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.  What You’ll Do   Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features  Shape the future of our Android team  Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features  Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering  Review pull requests, and support other teammates  Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges  Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team    An Ideal Candidate Should Have   5+ years of software engineering experience  Familiarity with Android components  Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app  Product design intuition and user empathy  Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX  Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests  Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec  Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests  Excellent communication skills  User oriented problem solving approach  Driven with continuous feedback from leaders    Bonus:   Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android  Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS    Technologies we use:   Kotlin  Kotlin Coroutines  Kotlin Flow  Jetpack Navigation  Dagger 2  Room  Custom Views, Canvas & Paint  Jetpack Compose  JUnit    What We offer:   A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.  An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.  A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.  An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.  Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.  Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.  Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.  Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.    Think you’re a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.  Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?  Refer them!  Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Resultados -Atuamos com eficiência, agilidade e simplicidade com foco em resultados, para gerar valor para a companhia no longo prazo. Fazemos isso com senso de dono, equilibrando os resultados esperados com a perenidade da companhia.   Consumidor -Temos o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões e trabalhamos para aprimorar sua experiência, seja no ambiente físico ou no digital.   Inovação -Somos inconformados e acreditamos que é possível fazer diferente. Mantemos a mente aberta, aprendemos e nos desafiamos a ser melhores todos os dias.   Time -Reconhecemos e valorizamos o desempenho individual e coletivo para o sucesso da companhia. Graduação (Superior Completo) Administração, Ciências Contábeis,Economia,Direito ou correlatas. Informações adicionais  Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Auxílio academia; Programa de remuneração variável; Seguro de vida; Vale alimentação; Vale-refeição;  Local:São Paulo/ SP. A mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam. Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil. Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de 15.000 lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão. Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros. Clique aqui para mais informações sobre como seus dados pessoais na condição de Pessoa Candidata são tratados pela ALLOS. DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO  AALLOS está comprometida com a criação e fomento de um ambiente de trabalho diverso, que acolha pessoas de raças, etnias, gêneros, origens, vivências e perfis variados, priorizando a inclusão social, a redução das desigualdades e práticas empregatícias justas, que promovam a igualdade de oportunidades. title: Product Owner
description:
Nova oportunidade para Product Owner em joaçaba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Nãos somos a Inovadora. Uma das principais empresas de software na área da saús e assistência social do Brasil.  Acreditamos na inovação e na tecnologia, mas só inova quem trabalha muito e quem desafia o impossível. Queremos crescer como empresa, como equipe e como pessoas.  Sua missão será:   Desenvolver soluções tecnológicas que impactam na velocidade e na qualitá dos serviços prestados na área da saús.  Sucesso do Cargo:   Garantir a evolução dos produtos da Inovadora, considerando a entrega de valor ao cliente e o alinhamento com os objetivos do nóvel de negócio.   Transformar a visão do produto em um backlog acionável, traduzindo as demandas em funcionalidades que agreguem valor à ele, ao cliente e ao negócio;  Analisar as demandas de evoluções do sistema, identificando se estão alinhadas com a visão do produto e classificando-as de acordo com o seu grau de importância;  Escrever as histórias das funcionalidades e definir critérios de aceitação, identificando os requisitos técnicos e os impactos dos processos envolvidos, ademais de estimar o tempo necessário para sua conclusão;  Criar, refinar e priorizar o backlog, identificando as tarefas que serão evoluídas no sprint e que deverão sair nas versões, com base no valor que cada uma trará para o cliente e para o negócio;  Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento, compartilhando cada uma das histórias, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo detalhes adicionais sobre os itens do backlog e garantindo que a equipe compreenda completamente os requisitos;  Aprovar as funcionalidades que foram desenvolvidas, avaliando se atendem aos critérios de aceitação definidos e decidindo se estão concluídas e podem ser lançadas, ou se há necessidade de ajustes adicionais;  Compartilhar as novas versões com o time responsável por fazer o lançamento, explicando as novas funcionalidades e como elas atendem às necessidades dos clientes;  Garantir que as documentações das funcionalidades do sistema sejam feitas, criando novas e mantendo atualizadas aquéas que foram afetadas com as melhorias realizadas;  Interagir com as partes interessadas, como clientes e demais áreas da Inovadora, coletando e fornecendo informações sobre as demandas, e atualizando o progresso, os planos futuros e as possíveis mudanças de rota.  Assume responsabilidades do plano da área;  Conhece o negócio e já entende melhor a interdependência das variáveis envolvidas;  Toma decisões operacionais que não necessariamente têm precedentes, entendendo o impacto da sua atuação no seu time e naqueles que tem mais interface;  Recebe as responsabilidades priorizadas e demanda orientação e apoio quando necessário;  Realiza entregas com diferentes complexidães, com predomínio das mais simples e padronizadas;  Faz boas entregas mesmo que demande esforço extra para a sua execução.    Requisitos  Escolaridade   Graduação    Habilidade Técnica   Metodologias ágeis - Intermediário  Comunicação oral e escrita - Intermediário  Banco de dados - Intermediário  Vale refeição  Vale alimentação  Convências Educacionais  Acesso ao convénio CDL | SESI | SESC    Localização  Rua Fernando Ferrari, 55, Nossa Sra. de Lourdes, Joaçaba - SC, Brasil,     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Information Technology Technician- Microsoft Endpoint and Cloud Systems
description:
Confira a vaga para Information Technology Technician- Microsoft Endpoint and Cloud Systems em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Information Technology Technician- Microsoft Endpoint and Cloud Systems  About Eurasia Group and GZERO Media   Eurasia Group is the world's leading global research and advisory firm. We help clients understand, anticipate, and respond to instability and opportunities everywhere they do business.  Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full-fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution.  Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, São Paulo, Brasilia, Tokyo, Singapore, and San Francisco, as well as on-the-ground experts in more than a hundred countries in every region of the world.  We are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.  Eurasia Group is currently seeking a highly skilled Tier III Information Technology Technician with deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, Azure administration, and Microsoft 365. This role will serve as a senior technical escalation point and subject matter expert for endpoint management, identity governance, and cloud service optimization.  Responsibilities   Be the go-to person for Microsoft Intune, Azure AD, and Microsoft 365—set up services, automate tasks, and handle tricky problems.  Set up and make sure devices follow company rules for security and setup using Intune for Windows, macOS, and iOS.  Take the lead on difficult tech issues that Tier I/II teams can’t solve, and work with outside IT support or vendors to get things fixed.  Use PowerShell to automate tasks so the team can work more efficiently and spend less time on repetitive work.  Handle the full life cycle of devices—from setting them up with Autopilot and managing app installations, to making sure they’re up to date with patches, and providing remote support.  Work with IT Security to watch for and fix issues with devices or user accounts, using Microsoft Defender and Conditional Access tools.  Help manage Azure AD, including group settings, application management, assigning roles, and licensing users.  Keep an eye on Microsoft 365’s status, and take the lead when rolling out new features, settings, or integrations.  Help plan and carry out IT projects, and be involved in making decisions about changes to the IT systems.  Train and support junior IT staff, keep clear documentation, and add to the team’s knowledge base.  Keep up with new Microsoft 365 updates and encourage best practices across the company.    Qualifications   Be the go-to expert on Microsoft Intune, Azure AD, and Microsoft 365—help set them up, automate tasks, and handle tricky issues.  Set up and enforce security and configuration rules for company devices (Windows, Mac, and iPhones/iPads) using Intune.  Take the lead on tough tech problems that others can’t fix, and work directly with outside IT partners to sort them out.  Use PowerShell scripts to automate tasks and make things run more smoothly, saving everyone time.  Oversee the whole device process—from setting up new laptops and phones, to pushing out apps, doing updates, and providing remote support.  Work with IT Security to keep devices and user identities secure, using Microsoft Defender and Conditional Access tools.  Help manage Azure AD settings like user groups, app permissions, and licenses.  Keep an eye on Microsoft 365 performance and handle updates, new features, and integrations.  Be part of IT change management and help out on IT projects.  Teach and support less experienced team members, write guides and instructions, and keep internal documentation up to date.  Keep up with Microsoft 365 updates and share best practices with the team.    Experience & Skills   At least 5 years working in IT support or infrastructure, with a focus on Microsoft cloud tools.  Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune—setting up policies, pushing out apps, and keeping devices compliant.  Know your way around Azure AD (things like SSO, multi-factor authentication, conditional access, and hybrid setups).  Comfortable writing PowerShell scripts; experience with Microsoft Graph API is a bonus.  Experience using security tools like Microsoft Defender, Trellix, or FIDO authentication.  Understand how Autopilot works, how to manage Windows updates, and how to watch for device health issues.  Good at problem-solving, managing lots of tasks at once, and explaining tech stuff to both technical and non-technical people.  Can clearly document what you do (write procedures, guides, etc.).  Can work independently and as part of a team.  Willing to keep learning and stay up-to-date with new Microsoft 365 features.  English fluency - spoken and written form    Skills   Strong knowledge of:  Intune: making configuration profiles, compliance policies, and app deployments.  Azure AD: SSO, Conditional Access, groups, and enterprise apps.  Experience managing devices running Windows 10/11, macOS 13/14, and iOS/iPadOS 16/17.  Comfortable with PowerShell (required); Microsoft Graph is a plus.  Know how to use security tools like Microsoft Defender and Trellix/FIDO, and set up Conditional Access policies.  Can support hardware like Dell laptops, Macs, iPhones, iPads, and common printers.  Familiar with ticketing tools like ServiceNow, and best practices for incident and change management.  Used to leading or helping run IT projects, writing technical documentation, and training others.    At Eurasia Group, our mission is to provide the tools and understanding needed in a world where politics drives disruption. We put politics first  for our clients, and we aspire to be the leading place people come to find out about the world. This requires us to maintain a company culture that puts people first. We are committed to fostering an environment that is empowering and globally minded. We firmly believe that bringing people with a variety of ideas and perspectives to the table makes our analysis stronger for our clients and creates a better workplace. Our leadership team is dedicated to embedding this approach into everything we do and how we lead because we care deeply about our work and our people.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead Community Support Facilitator (Santa Maria)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Lead Community Support Facilitator (Santa Maria) em santa maria. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Lead Community Support Facilitator (Santa Maria)  Life Steps Foundation Central Coast Adult Services is a social service agency that serves individuals with intellectual disabilities. Our goal is to help adults of all ages maximize their independence, support individual needs and choices, and assist in maintaining a desired quality of life.  As a Lead Community Support Staff (case manager) you will teach and assist adults of all ages in learning a broad range of independent living skills. Services are provided on a one‑to‑one basis and in the community, servicing the San Luis Obispo, Santa Maria, and Lompoc area.  Responsibilities   Deliver person‑centered services that respect personal preferences, sexual orientation, and culture, and promote balance of self‑responsibility and self‑reliance.  Identify natural and community supports and assist the individual to use them.  Develop in collaboration with the individual and his or her support system a person‑centered plan.  Foster self‑determination congruent with the individual’s desires and interests.  Provide life‑management in need areas identified by the individual and health and safety training to individuals and pertinent support system persons.  Assist individuals with the recruitment, hiring, and supervision of direct support staff and generic resources.  Assist with finding roommates and housing.  Ensure the individual can provide direction to the services and make decisions about the character and appearance of his or her home environment.  Support the individual to learn life‑management skills according to their identified needs, including medical, household, financial, and community mobility management.  Assist in creating a health and safety plan that is consistent with the individual’s needs and wants as well as Life Steps requirements and scope of competency.     Submit accurate, complete and legible billing and payroll documents in a timely manner.  Adhere to approved monthly schedule.  Consistently complete authorized service hours.  Maintain and submit timely and accurate documentation, including person‑centered plans, daily documentation, adult abuse reports, child abuse reports, special incident reports, and other reporting requirements such as court orders.  Demonstrate competency (as evidenced by field supervision) in the standards of care to be delivered by the CSF scope of practice and in accordance with the Service Design.  Support individual, support system, and family participation in program planning.  Provide service that is absent of substantiated individual complaints.  Review the SLS handbook with individuals on an annual basis.  Ensure that all individuals’ case files, notes, and progress notes are organized in their chart and are complete, accurate, and up to standards.    Provide highest quality services through ongoing quality assurance:  Meet with Program Supervisor weekly to discuss the case, any issues raised by the individual or staff, set action items, evaluate performance, and other items by agenda.  Make home visits to individual homes to ensure employees are delivering quality service if deemed necessary by a Supervisor.  Assist Supervisor, if necessary, with completing reports and ensuring delivery to Regional Center.  Provide quality direct service to individuals as necessary.   Adhere to all Life Steps’ performance standards for CSF and DSS when providing direct service to individuals, including avoiding dual relationships.  Provide emergency coverage of cases or assignment of worker for coverage.  Subscribe to and uphold all professional ethical standards.  Recognize and adhere to individual/lead facilitator boundaries at all times.  Maintain high standards of personal conduct in the capacity of lead facilitator when providing direct service to individuals.  Respect the privacy of individuals and maintain confidentiality of information obtained in the course of professional service.    Essential Job Requirements   BA in psychology, human development, or social service or equivalent years of experience or training in direct service to consumers with developmental disabilities; High School diploma or GED.  Good verbal and written communication skills.  Must be able to lift/transport consumer(s) in event of emergency.  Current certifications in CPR and First Aid.  Physical restraint techniques of assaultive behavior (CPI or PART) in programs requiring this training.  Must have a valid California Driver’s License and current automobile insurance.  Must be able to attend monthly staff trainings and supervision.  Basic computer skills and word processing necessary.    Pay Range  $18.00 – $18.50 per hour  Location  Santa Maria, CA (servicing the San Luis Obispo, Santa Maria, and Lompoc area)  Senior Level & Employment Type  Entry Level, Full‑time  Job Function  Other – Individual and Family Services   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas:  Localização:  São Paulo, BR - São Paulo, Brasil,    Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.  Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.  Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Descrição da vaga  Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ✈️   Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados;somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções .  Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.  Estas são oportunidades exclusivas para PcDs  na nossa base em POA .  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:   Auxiliar de Rampa     As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto. Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.   Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)     As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.  Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.  Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.  Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.   Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)     As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.  Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.  Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.  Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.  Requisitos e qualificações   Ensino médio concluído;  Boa comunicação interpessoal;  Proatividade;  Vontade de aprender;  Vontade de trabalhar em equipe;  Disciplina e organização;  Disponibilidade de horário e para trabalhar em turnos rotativos presenciais;    Informações adicionais  Todos os envios de CV devem vir obrigatoriamente acompanhados do "LAUDO CARACTERIZADOR DE DEFICIÊNCIA ". title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Porto Alegre, Brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Porto Alegre, Brazil em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.  Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.  Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.  Overview  With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.  This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast‑paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.  We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.  Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.  What You’ll Do   Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features  Shape the future of our Android team  Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features  Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering  Review pull requests, and support other teammates  Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges  Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team    An Ideal Candidate Should Have   5+ years of software engineering experience  Familiarity with Android components  Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app  Product design intuition and user empathy  Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX  Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests  Self‑drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what’s outlined in the spec  Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests  Excellent communication skills  User oriented problem solving approach  Driven with continuous feedback from leaders    Bonus   Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android  Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS    Technologies we use   Kotlin  Kotlin Coroutines  Kotlin Flow  Jetpack Navigation  Dagger 2  Room  Custom Views, Canvas & Paint  Jetpack Compose  JUnit    What We offer   A fast‑growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.  An entrepreneurial‑minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.  A hands‑off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.  An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.  Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid‑back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.  Opportunity to work on a life‑changing product that millions of people use.  Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.  Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.    Think you’re a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you’re interested in the role when you apply.And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.  Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?  Refer them!  Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Instituto Ar abre vaga afirmativa para Analista Sênior de Políticas Públicas
description:
Confira a vaga para Instituto Ar abre vaga afirmativa para Analista Sênior de Políticas Públicas em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O Instituto Ar , referência nacional na articulação entre saúde pública, qualidade do ar e enfrentamento da crise climática, está com processo seletivo aberto para a contratação de um(a) Analista Sênior de Políticas Públicas . A vaga é afirmativa para indígenas, pessoas negras, mulheres, pessoas LGBTQIA+ e pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), e busca ampliar a incidência da organização na agenda climática por meio da atuação estratégica em advocacy e diálogo com o poder público. Confira abaixo o descritivo da vaga enviada à ABCR:  Para ampliar nossa atuação em advocacy e políticas públicas , buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de Políticas Públicas , responsável por articular iniciativas estratégicas, representar o Instituto e liderar a Coalizão Respira Amazônia , atuando de forma transversal em toda a agenda de políticas públicas do Instituto.  O(A) contratado(a) será responsável por coordenar iniciativas de diálogo, análise e formulação de propostas junto a tomadores de decisão, gestores públicos e parceiros estratégicos, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do papel do Instituto Ar no enfrentamento das mudanças climáticas sob a perspectiva da saúde humana.  Abaixo os detalhes da oportunidade:  Principais Atividades:   Monitorar e analisar políticas públicas nacionais e internacionais relacionadas à mudança climática, mobilidade urbana sustentável, qualidade do ar e saúde, identificando oportunidades de incidência.  Apoiar a formulação de posicionamentos institucionais, notas técnicas, policy briefs e recomendações de políticas baseadas em evidências científicas.  Coordenar o relacionamento com órgãos governamentais, parlamentares, redes de advocacy e parceiros estratégicos, articulando ações conjuntas.  Articular diretamente com ministérios e órgãos públicos em nome do Instituto Ar, representando institucionalmente suas agendas prioritárias.  Representar o Instituto em espaços de diálogo político, reuniões, audiências e eventos institucionais, apresentando evidências e recomendações.  Planejar e acompanhar a execução de agendas de advocacy, alinhando prioridades internas com janelas de oportunidade externas.  Facilitar a integração entre equipe técnica, gestão institucional e parceiros externos, garantindo clareza de prioridades e coesão das mensagens.  Apoiar a organização de campanhas de mobilização e engajamento relacionadas à pauta de clima, saúde e mobilidade sustentável.  Produzir relatórios periódicos de acompanhamento das políticas e dos resultados de incidência.  Capacitar a equipe interna e parceiros em temas de políticas públicas e estratégias de advocacy.  Contribuir para a produção de materiais institucionais e apresentações voltadas a financiadores, gestores públicos e sociedade civil.  Identificar riscos políticos e institucionais, propondo ações preventivas para mitigação.  Liderar a Coalizão Respira Amazônia, iniciativa do Instituto Ar, atuando como ponto focal e responsável pela manutenção do relacionamento com parceiros/stakeholders e pela representação oficial da Coalizão perante atores públicos, privados e da sociedade civil.    Requisitos:  Formação e Experiência:   Graduação completa em Ciências Políticas, Relações Internacionais, Direito, Administração Pública, Saúde Coletiva ou áreas correlatas;  Experiência comprovada (mínimo 3 anos) em políticas públicas, advocacy ou articulação institucional, preferencialmente em temas relacionados a clima, saúde, mobilidade sustentável ou meio ambiente;  Histórico de atuação em articulação com órgãos governamentais de alto nível (ministérios, secretarias, parlamento);  Vivência em relacionamento com gestores públicos, parlamentares, organismos multilaterais e sociedade civil organizada;  Experiência em elaboração de notas técnicas, relatórios e posicionamentos políticos;  Experiência no uso de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Monday, Trello ou similares);  Experiência no terceiro setor é considerado um diferencial.    Habilidades e Competências:   Inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório) – leitura, escrita e conversação;  Excelente comunicação oral e escrita em português;  Capacidade de articulação política e de negociação;  Organização, visão estratégica e proatividade;  Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e de construir relacionamentos com múltiplos stakeholders;  Pensamento crítico e visão sistêmica.    Conhecimentos Técnicos:   Domínio avançado do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);  Familiaridade com ferramentas Google (Google Agenda, Meet, Docs, Sheets);  Noções de análise de políticas públicas e metodologias de monitoramento e avaliação.    Características Pessoais:   Organização, agilidade e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficaz;  Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução;  Capacidade de análise e síntese em contextos complexos;  Comprometimento com a missão e os valores do Instituto;  Facilidade para lidar com diferentes perfis e culturas.    Disponibilidade:   Para viagens nacionais e, eventualmente, internacionais;  Para participar de eventos e reuniões fora do horário comercial, quando necessário.    Sobre a oportunidade:   Regime de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).  Remuneração: R$9.100,00  Descanso remunerado: 2,5 dias por mês trabalhado, o que totaliza um descanso remunerado anual de 30 dias.  Trabalho híbrido: Encontros presenciais 2x por semana.  Localização: Alocação em São Paulo (Região Central e Itaim Bibi).  Vaga afirmativa: Esta vaga é afirmativa para indígenas, pessoas negras, mulheres, pessoas da comunidade LGBTQIA+ e PCD ‘s.    Interessados(as) devem preencher o formulário disponível em forms até o dia 19/12/2025.   Importante:  Propostas enviadas fora das orientações acima não serão avaliadas.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: License Owner, Sao Paulo
description:
Confira a vaga para License Owner, Sao Paulo em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Passionate about football (soccer) AND about business? Stranger Soccer is expanding to key cities around the world. We are looking for a License Owner to open and operate the Stranger Soccer business in Sao Paulo.  This is not your traditional management job – it is truly built for someone that wants to own and operate their own business (that happens to make the world's greatest sport accessible to everyone). This role is ideally suited for an adventurous and football‑passionate entrepreneur.  Responsibilities   Bring the Stranger Soccer brand and business to life for the assigned city.  Recruit, train, and lead a small central team (2‑3 persons) as well as a few freelance Official Hosts (game hosts) to kick off the operation.  Identify and secure prime slots at football venues to run Stranger Soccer games.  Engage in creative sales and marketing digital and hands‑to‑hands to ensure that customers are introduced to the platform as a convenient and preferred way to play.  Oversee a schedule of games, ensuring customers are delighted with each game they play, and keep coming back for more.  Take advantage of the strong backing and direction of Singapore headquarters, where an operations and technology team is ready to support you.    Qualifications   A passion for football, and a strong connection to your local football scene.  A business background, ideally in management and customer service.  An entrepreneurial background or spirit.  A commitment to owning, driving, and scaling the Stranger Soccer brand in the assigned market.  A hunger to succeed – financial compensation for this role will be proportionate to hard work, business acumen, and effectiveness.    About Stranger Soccer  With 3.5 billion football enthusiasts in over 200 countries, football is the most popular sport in the world. But why don't more people play it? Stranger Soccer ( makes playing football as easy as going for a jog or to the gym. Browse dozens of games on its acclaimed Mobile App. Book a slot. Turn up and play. Incorporated in 2017, Stranger Soccer has quickly transformed the sports & recreation scene in Singapore. In a few short years, it has grown to be the #1‑way people play football and futsal in the country, amassing tens of thousands of registered users purchasing thousands of slots every week. Whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or anything else, the world now awaits.  Our Mission  To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.  Our Vision  A world in which playing football is as popular and widespread as watching football.  Got what it takes?  We encourage you to visit   to learn more about this dynamic opportunity, and to express your interest. Be sure to download and explore the Stranger Soccer mobile app as well. We look forward to meeting you.  Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level  Employment type: Full‑time  Job function: Other  Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades. Todos os inscritos no processo seletivo receberão o feedback positivo ou negativo, durante ou após o término do processo seletivo. title: Strategy Insights & Planning Associate

Essa história é feita por pessoas que acreditam que o trabalho em equipe é o que nos diferencia. We build long-form video strategies that create real authority and drive actual business results.  The proof is in our growth:   Scaling fast from 55 to 200+ channels  Building systematic production operations that work at scale  Helping agents win deals through strategic content, not viral gimmicks    We believe in extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and beyond excellence. If that resonates, you'll thrive here.  We're hiring a Lead Editor to deliver high-quality edits consistently and help us maintain our quality standards across the team as we scale.   As a Lead Editor at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of video editors  who transform raw real estate content into high-impact YouTube videos that help agents dominate their local markets. This is a player-coach leadership role  where you'll spend 70-90% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 10-30% hands-on editing complex projects.  You’ll own editing quality standards, team development, and operational excellence  within your pod, partnering closely with Pod Managers, YouTube Managers, and Strategists to deliver retention-driven content at scale. Your success is measured not by how many videos you edit, but by how well your team performs, grows, and retains talent.  This role is perfect for someone who loves developing editors as much as editing itself  and gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying their impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands‑on without management responsibilities, or purely hands‑off without getting in the weeds of editing, this isn't the right fit.  Team Leadership & Development (50% of role)   Manage and develop 25-50 video editors, conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill progression and performance (with the support of multiple Senior Editors & YouTube Managers)  Lead weekly team edit reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing  Lead monthly team trainings for the editing team culture & growth  Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new editor hires  Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for your team  Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework  Participate in hiring (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring recommendations)  Build 2-5+ year relationships with editors approval for complex or high-stakes edits before client delivery  Lead A/B testing strategy and retention analysis, translating data into actionable editing improvements  Create efficiency systems (templates, motion graphics libraries, workflow optimizations)  Build performance dashboards tracking team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention performance)  Drive continuous vision  Communicate proactively with leadership on team capacity, blockers, and resource needs  Contribute to quarterly planning and annual strategy with editing function perspective  Handle client escalations and quality issues with transparency and solutions-focused approach    Player-Coach Editing (10-20% of role)   Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per month for VIP clients or training demonstrations  Model excellence by staying hands‑on with the craft and maintaining YouTube editing fluency  Stay current on YouTube editing trends, competitor content, and platform algorithm changes  Experiment with new techniques and tools, sharing learnings and innovations with the team  Maintain organized project files and asset management as an example for the team    Requirements  We're looking for someone who combines exceptional editing craft with proven leadership ability. You should be passionate about developing talent and building systems that multiply impact across a team, not just delivering great edits yourself.  Leadership & Management Experience   5-7+ years of professional video editing experience  with 2+ years managing or leading editors   Proven track record developing and scaling editing teams of 4+ people  Experience hiring editors (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring decisions)  Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality  History of conducting performance reviews and managing accountability (including difficult conversations)  Experience building onboarding programs, training materials, and documented workflows  Comfortable with the full people management cycle: hiring, coaching, performance management, and when necessary, firing    Technical Mastery (You Can Teach Others)   Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro  – you can troubleshoot complex technical issues and teach advanced techniques  Strong proficiency in After Effects  for motion graphics and visual effects  Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve, Blender, or other tools (or quick learner)  Deep understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, storytelling, and algorithm optimization  Ability to QA others' work and identify issues across editing style, technical execution, and brand consistency  Portfolio showcasing both your own work AND examples of team development     Systems & Process Thinking   Experience building scalable editing workflows, style guides, and template systems  Understanding of capacity planning and resource allocation for editing teams  Ability to create performance dashboards and track team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention)  Skilled at documentation – SOPs, training materials, and knowledge management  Process optimization mindset – constantly looking for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality  Experience with project management tools (Asana, Notion, Frame.io) and team collaboration systems    Strategic & Business Acumen   Ability to translate business objectives into editing strategy and creative direction  Comfortable presenting to clients and defending creative decisions with data and performance insights  Understanding of editing team economics (capacity planning, turnaround times, quality vs. speed tradeoffs)  Experience partnering cross-functionally with strategists, writers, designers, and YouTube managers  Can navigate ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information  Thinks beyond individual edits to how editing impacts channel growth and client business results    Communication & Influence   Exceptional written and verbal communication  for feedback, presentations, and team documentation  Ability to give direct, constructive feedback that motivates rather than demoralizes  Skilled at managing up (keeping leadership informed), across (collaborating with peers), and down (developing direct reports)  Proactive communication style – you flag capacity issues, quality concerns, and team challenges before they become crises  Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, client escalations, conflict resolution)  Can translate technical editing concepts into language that non-editors understand    Work Style & Mindset   Player-coach mentality  – willing to stay hands-on with editing (10-20% of time) while primarily focusing on team leadership  Excellent organizational skills managing both your own work and your team's project pipeline  Ability to balance competing priorities: team development, quality standards, client deadlines, and strategic initiatives  Comfortable context-switching between hands-on editing, team coaching, client calls, and strategic planning  Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are constantly evolving  Gets energized by developing talent and seeing team members succeed  Extreme Ownership  – Takes full accountability for team results; models this for direct reports  Beyond Excellence  – Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to consistently exceed them  Proactive Curiosity  – Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of issues  Mission Focus  – Obsesses about client success and team development, not personal recognition    Results You'll Drive  Team Performance   Your editing team consistently maintains >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors  Editor retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression  New editors productive at 80% capacity within 60 days through your training systems  100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter  Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization – productive output without burnout    Quality & Systems   Zero client escalations due to editing quality issues or missed deadlines from your team  95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio  Editing workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide  Average video retention improves 5-10% year-over-year through data-driven editing strategies    Strategic Impact   Editing function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership  Successfully contribute to client strategy with editing insights that drive performance  Your team supports clients publishing 4+ videos per month consistently  Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for editing quality and communication  At least 1-2 editors promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship  Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per week as benchmarks and training examples  Your edits consistently achieve 8-10% average retention (above platform benchmarks)  Model extreme ownership, excellence, and proactive curiosity through your work    COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:  Salary:  $36,000 - $60,000 USD annually (based on experience and team size managed)  What We Offer:   Fully Remote  Flexible Time Off policy (we trust you to manage your time and energy)  Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software  Opportunities to earn Monthly wellness allowance, Home office stipend, Professional development budget &/or Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period)  Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria    REAL TALK:  This is an early-stage startup scaling rapidly. You'll face challenges – processes break, priorities shift, and things get messy. We need people who are resilient, resourceful, and committed long-term.  But if you want to:   Build a world-class editing team  and multiply your impact 10x  Develop editors and watch them grow beyond their potential  Help America's top real estate leaders dominate their local markets  Build something meaningful  from 55 to 200+ channels    This is the place.  This role is player-coach (10-25% hands-on editing, 75%+ leadership).  If you want to focus purely on editing without managing people, this isn't the right fit.  Location  Remote-first  Our Core Values   Extreme Ownership  – Take responsibility for your work and outcomes. No excuses, just solutions.  Beyond Excellence  – Care about the details. Deliver work that exceeds expectations.  Proactive Curiosity  – Don't wait to be told. Ask questions, identify problems, suggest solutions.  Mission Focus  – Remember: your edits help real estate agents build their businesses. That matters.    We primarily look at those who apply above.  Pay $36K - $60K+ USD a year (depending on experience)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

A crença no poder dos sonhos, traduzida no slogan mundial da marca Honda – The Power of Dreams – é um dos principais legados deixados pelo criador da empresa, Soichiro Honda. A Honda acredita que o sonho é a força criativa, capaz de produzir ideias inovadoras. A companhia procura, por meio de seus produtos e serviços, proporcionar experiências diferenciadas e seguras às pessoas. Também acredita que apoiar colaboradores e comunidades na realização de seus desejos é uma forma de construir um futuro melhor. Na Orbia Building & Infrastructure, promovemos a vida em todo o mundo construindo ambientes saudáveis e sustentáveis. E onde é que a nossa ajuda é mais necessária? Estamos atualmente procurando uma Pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Sr para se juntar a nós em Suma ré/SP .e Se você quer continuar fazendo a diferença e crescer em uma empresa com propósito, verifique os requisitos necessários e se inscreva.  Como Pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Sr. você vai.   Identificar, selecionar e atrair candidatos potenciais alinhados com a cultura, visão e valores da organização, garantindo o suprimento do melhor capital humano suportando as áreas clientes a atingir os resultados. Experiência na condução de processos seletivos envolvendo: diversos níveis e para diversas áreas, elaboração de perfis, contato com consultorias de RH, entrevistas à distância; Entrevista por competências; Dinâmicas de Grupo; Conhecimento em Instrumentos de seleção e avaliação de perfil; Conhecimento em metodologias de avaliação de perfil / assessment de candidato. Pós-graduação / MBA em gestão de pessoas ou afins  O que o Orbia Building & Infrastructure oferece? Quer fazer a diferença trabalhando com um propósito? Aqui assumimos a responsabilidade uns pelos outros e pela nossa empresa. Continuamos corajosos na busca de riscos calculados que alimentam a inovação. E abraçamos a diversidade em perspectivas, habilidades e talentos para transformar a maneira como trabalhamos e o impacto que temos no mundo. Acima de tudo, incentivamos todos os nossos colaboradores a desenvolverem seus talentos e a se tornarem a melhor versão de si mesmos. Juntos, como uma equipe forte, crescemos e cumprimos nosso propósito todos os dias. Orbia B&I é o lugar para estar se você realmente deseja causar um impacto. Além de trabalhar com uma equipe profissional e entusiasmada em um ambiente internacional, oferecemos um pacote competitivo de remuneração e benefícios. Plano de saúde para os colaboradores e sua família; Garantimos 6 meses de licença maternidade e 20 dias de licença paternidade; Durante a gestação, Isenção de qualquer tipo de cobrança de coparticipação de consultas e exames; Auxílio creche durante os 03 primeiros anos da criança; Todos os colaboradores efetivos e seus dependentes possuem convênio médico e pagamos 50% do valor dos medicamentos necessários para tratamentos; Convênio odontológico para os colaboradores e sua família; Parceria com a plataforma Moodar (descontos em terapia online); Parceria com a plataforma Wellhub (academias físicas e aplicativos parceiros); Refeição para os colaboradores, seja nos restaurantes internos nas fábricas; Para colaboradores e familiares, temos convênios educacionais com instituições de ensino; Desconto em produtos da marca para reformar com a melhor opção do mercado; E por último, mas não menos importante um dia de folga no seu aniversário! At Teleflex, we are empowering the future of healthcare. For more information, please visit teleflex.com .  Interventional  The Interventional business unit at Teleflex offers innovative medical devices that are used to diagnose and treat coronary and peripheral vascular diseases. We place a strategic emphasis on complex coronary and peripheral interventions, vascular access, bone access, specialty biologic treatments and cardiac assist. Our current Interventional products include a broad range of clinically relevant solutions, such as our GuideLiner™ and Turnpike™ Catheters, Ringer™ Perfusion Balloon Catheter, AC3 Optimus™ and AC3 Range™ Intra‑Aortic Balloon Pumps and the OnControl™ Powered Bone Access System. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.  Position Summary  The Medical Education Manager serves as a subject matter expert in Interventional Cardiology, advancing patient care through education and collaboration. This role partners with cross‑functional teams to deliver impactful training, provide guidance on product safety and efficacy, and support clinical adoption through evidence‑based programs. Experience in the Medical Device Industry preferred.  Fluency in English and Spanish is required.    Specialized Skills / Other Requirements   Recognized and respected within the specialty community, active member of relevant professional societies.  Strong reputation among peers with demonstrated credibility and expertise.  Deep understanding of market needs and current solutions; capable of developing strategic plans to address unmet patient requirements.  Proven ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.  Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).  Skilled in problem‑solving, data analysis, and drawing sound conclusions.  Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver clear, professional presentations.  Adaptable to change and comfortable working in a fluid environment.  Ability to interpret clinical evidence and integrate findings into product and procedural education.  Strong collaboration skills, building effective relationships internally within a matrixed organization and externally with diverse partners.  Experienced in navigating regulatory requirements while achieving business objectives.  Effective negotiation and consensus‑building skills; able to influence and align stakeholders.  Willingness to travel up to 60% regionally, including overnight trips. All CMA colleagues are expected to perform with the highest levels of professionalism, service, and ethics in order to strengthen the Teleflex brand and relationship with our customers.  Continuous Improvement – Demonstrates initiative and critical thinking to identify and prioritize process and performance gaps. Develops solutions to deliver improved results. Culture and Values – Exemplifies Teleflex values and ensures a fair, open, and productive climate that is engaging, ethical, and legally compliant. Lead and participate in the process of promotional and other materials, working internally and cross‑functionally to ensure materials are processed completely, based on accurate interpretation of clinical practice and data. A SPDM  - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.  A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. title: Financial Business Analyst / Quality Assurance (Brazil)
description:

Introduction  Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.  Overview  Gallagher is a global leader in insurance, risk management and consulting services. We help businesses grow, communities thrive and people prosper. We live a culture defined by The Gallagher Way, our set of shared values and guiding tenets. A culture driven by our people, over 50,000 strong, serving our clients with customized solutions that will protect them and fuel their futures.  We are seeking a senior Business Analyst / Quality Assurance Analyst to play a pivotal role in the Global System Implementation program in Brazil, deploying JDE (ERP/GL/AP/PO/FA), Kyriba (Treasury), Circulus (AP Automation) and Concur (T&E).  This role will work closely with global teams, local stakeholders, and the external implementation vendor to ensure that local requirements and regulatory needs are accurately captured, designed, tested, and delivered in alignment with the global template and program standards.  The person in this role will act as the main link between Brazil’s business and finance teams and the vendor, making sure local needs are clearly understood and correctly implemented. Strong knowledge of Accounting and Finance, experience with financial system implementations, and solid QA skills are essential.  How you'll make an impact   Solution Design   Lead, collect and document business requirements with Accounting (General Ledger, Chart of Accounts), Finance, Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Trade and Non-Trade Accounts Payable, Procurement, Treasury Management (Kyriba), Tax, Master Data, Travel & Expense (Concur), Operations, and other business areas. Translate needs into clear business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.  Support solution design sessions with the vendor and global teams.  Perform fit-gap analysis against the global template (JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur), proposing viable localization designs for Brazil.  Create process maps (as-is / to-be) and help define internal controls.  Support data related activities such as mapping, validation, and master data definitions.      Quality Assurance & Testing Leadership   Create and maintain the testing plan including functional, integration, regression, and UAT.  Write or review test cases and ensure all requirements have clear acceptance criteria.  Track and manage defects, helping teams resolve issues quickly.  Organize and support User Acceptance Testing with business users.  Document test results and prepare materials for go live readiness.      Change Management, Training & Adoption   Support change impact assessments, stakeholder communications, and training (materials, playbooks).  Prepare training materials and help run training sessions when needed.  Work with teams to ensure successful adoption of the new tools and processes.      Brazil Localization, Controls & Compliance   Ensure system design meets Brazilian accounting, tax and regulatory requirements (e.g., SPED ECD/ECF, withholding taxes, ICMS / ISS / IOF / PIS / COFINS, CNAB banking files), aligning with global accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP) and internal control frameworks (SOX, Segregation of Duties).  Review impacts on financial close, reconciliations, tax calculations and audit requirements.  Validate rules related to taxes, reporting, electronic documents, and other local obligations.      Data, Integration & Banking Connectivity   Work with the vendor and IT teams to define and validate integration interfaces across systems (JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur, Tax/Invoice Vendor, Payroll).  Support data migration activities, including data preparation, testing and reconciliation.  Assist in designing and validating bank connections, payment files and statement imports.  Support environment setup and infrastructure configuration, including validation of system environments, connectivity and technical readiness.  Test and validate user access, roles and permissions across JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur and integrated systems.  Coordinate and test connectivity and integration flows with the Corporate JDE environment and other global platforms.  Work with IT teams to troubleshoot environment issues, interface failures, access problems and technical dependencies.      Vendor & Stakeholder Management   Work closely with the implementation partner, reviewing deliverables and tracking progress.  Monitor open issues, follow up on deadlines and help manage scope changes.  Ensure the vendor understands local needs and delivers solutions that work for Brazil.  Communicate risks and problems early to avoid delays.  Align global, regional (LatAm) and local stakeholders through clear status reporting, demos and decision logs.      Delivery Methodology & Governance   Work within Agile/Hybrid delivery (backlog management, sprint planning, demos/retros, release readiness).  Maintain rigorous project documentation (requirements, configurations, test evidence, SOPs), ensuring auditability and knowledge transfer.  Support cutover planning, go live preparation and hypercare after deployment.        About you   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field.  8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or QA Analyst.  Solid grounding in Accounting/Finance processes (period close, accruals, reconciliations, AP/AR, T&E), with understanding of IFRS/US GAAP; Brazil statutory/tax familiarity is essential.  Proven experience implementing systems such as JDE, Kyriba, Concur or AP automation tools.  Experience with integrations, data migration and banking processes. Vale refeição ou alimentação mensal em cartão VR Benefícios; Opção de convênios médico e odontológico com desconto em folha de pagamento; Apoio à saúde mental e física através das parcerias com a Uniser do Vale e DDF Fitness; Formação continuada através de ações internas promovidas pela escola; Subsídio para realização de cursos relacionados à sua atuação; Programa de descontos e bolsas de estudo para até três filhos nas unidades Moppe; Espaço de descanso aos colaboradores com estrutura ao ar livre e redário.  Esta é a nossa plataforma de banco de talentos e gestão de vagas e recrutamento, que nos auxilia na busca por candidatos alinhados com nossa cultura e perfil.  Aqui você pode se cadastrar para participar dos processos seletivos.  E isso só é possível graças à dedicação de nossos colaboradores, chamados carinhosamente de "moppeanos", que têm uma paixão genuína por educação. É assim desde o início. Seguimos norteados em ser uma escola de vanguarda e carregamos esse diferencial até mesmo em nosso nome, Moderna Orientação Psicopedagógica (Moppe). Fomos criados em 1982, a partir de um sonho da Teresinha, nossa diretora. Ela tinha o desejo de construir uma escola diferente de tudo o que se praticava na época, uma escola que formasse alunos muito além do conteúdo e isso só foi possível com o encontro de outras pessoas que compartilhavam deste mesmo ideal. É por esses e outros motivos que nos orgulhamos de oferecer a base mais forte aos nossos alunos. E para construirmos essa base forte, contamos com processos de seleção de excelência, diversas estratégias e tecnologias, a fim de encontrar as pessoas certas para ajudar em nossa missão. Aqui na Moppe você vai encontrar um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico, afetivo, com uma história e missão valorosa. E saiba que aqui o foco está na parceria, pois independente da área de atuação na escola, buscamos pessoas criativas e movidas pela paixão em aprender, construir e melhorar continuamente aquilo pelo que forem responsáveis.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Public Safety Relations Senior Manager
description:
